tools.name: lookup_member
tools.description: Look up one public member by exact display name or slug. This is not free-text directory search and returns only minimal public information.

tools.name: get_community_stats
tools.description: Get the roughly-live Agent Community member count. The count is cached for up to 20 minutes.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Pre-register a .agent identity through the DMV. This is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and should run only after an explicit user request.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Verify the live DMV issuance state of a canonical certificate ID. This does not confer domain ownership or mean the .agent TLD exists in DNS.
